title: Sample post: a paper with code, talks and data
summary: This sample post exercises every part of the blog layout: a paper, a code repository, a project page, videos, a dataset and slides. It also uses math, a code block and an inline resource card.
keyFindings: The resource bar shows one button per kind of resource.
Videos load only after a reader clicks play.
Inline shortcodes place a resource card inside the body.
body:
This is a **sample post** used to test the blog. It is never published on the live site; it only appears in builds run with `BLOG_FIXTURES=1`.

## What does the post layout include?

A title, a byline with linked authors, an "In short" box, the body and a resources section. Headings get stable anchors so an answer engine can link straight to a section.

## How is math rendered?

Inline math like $E = mc^2$ and display math are rendered to HTML at build time:

$$
\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}
$$

## How is code shown?

```python
def greet(name: str) -> str:
    return f"Hello, {name}"
```

## Can resources appear inside the text?

Yes. The shortcode below places the discussion video here:

::resource{id="video-discussion"}

A bare link on its own line is upgraded to a card too:

https://github.com/thirdspace-uoft/thirdspace-uoft.github.io

| Feature | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Tables | GitHub-flavoured Markdown |
| Footnotes | Supported[^1] |

![The lab's logo](/group-photos/IMG_0858_YVOiNQAIS.webp "An image with a caption")

[^1]: Footnotes render at the end of the post.
